focus.name: player-contact-state-family
focus.purpose: Promote handhold contact, interaction-state entry, and transition-contact player-collision paths to behavior-based canonical names.

contracts.handhold: resolve Type-0x69/0x6A contact in a 12-pixel vertical window, promote the actor to Type 0x6B with the matching handhold animation, and publish its interaction value
contracts.interaction: when animation/action/interaction locks are clear, reset TERRAIN_RESPONSE_TIMER_STATE and call Player_ProcessInteractionState
contracts.transition: resolve Type-0x50/0x51 contact in a 10-pixel vertical window, publish player position/transition locks, and promote Type 0x50 to Type 0x51
